data.title: Bitcoin climbs above $70K and gold rises after cooler PPI report
data.description: Bitcoin pushed back above $70,000 on November 13, 2026, after a producer inflation report came in a touch cooler than Wall Street expected. Gold followed it up, trading above $3,900 per ounce.The moves were modest. Bitcoin gained approximately 1-1.35%, and gold added around 0.6-1%. Still, in a week…
